B01.summary: Engine hangs (infinite loop) when DIATRABALHO gets a fractional number of days
B01.culprit: nucleo.ts:343 (DIATRABALHO: `while (n !== 0)` with n -= ±1 never hits 0; Excel truncates days)

B02.summary: Single-cell references passed to SOMA/MÉDIA/MÍNIMO/MÁXIMO/MED are coerced like typed values: empty cell counts as 0, text cell → #VALOR!, TRUE/'7' are summed. Excel ignores empty/text/boolean cells reached through a reference
B02.culprit: nucleo.ts:192-200 (numericos: non-matrix result of a `ref` goes through num())

B03.summary: Whole-column/whole-row references (A:A, 1:1) are rejected as a syntax error
B03.culprit: parser.ts:21 REF regex + parser.ts:108 (range needs row numbers on both ends)

B04.summary: Formula whose result is an empty cell (=A6, =SEERRO(A6;0), DESLOC to empty) shows blank instead of 0; downstream ÉCÉL.VAZIA sees it as empty
B04.culprit: nucleo.ts:694 (Calculo.calcular stores null; Excel turns a reference to an empty cell into 0)

B05.summary: Wildcards (* ? ~) not supported in exact-match PROCV/PROCH/CORRESP (Excel supports them); also no ~ escape in CONT.SE/SOMASE criteria

B06.summary: PROCX ignores match_mode and search_mode (5th/6th args): no approximate (-1/1), no wildcard (2), no last-to-first (-1)

B07.summary: An omitted argument (`;;` or trailing `;`) is parsed as the empty text "" instead of 'missing/0': PROCX(...;;0) returns "" instead of #N/D, SE(c;;1) returns "" instead of 0, SEQUÊNCIA(2;;5) returns nothing, DESLOC(r;0;0;;) → #REF!

B08.summary: Text comparison/sorting uses code points, not Excel collation: accented letters sort after Z ("É">"Z"), affects =, <, CLASSIFICAR, approximate lookups

B09.summary: AND/OR (E/OU) do not ignore empty cells / text reached through references (E(A1;A6) → FALSO, E(A1>0;B1) → #VALOR!), and short-circuit so later errors are not reported

B10.summary: SOMARPRODUTO counts TRUE/FALSE as 1/0; Excel treats booleans as 0, which is why the --(cond) idiom exists. SOMARPRODUTO(F1:F10="ana") gives 2 in the simulator but 0 in Excel

B11.summary: TEXTO: unsupported format codes – d/m single letters, ddd/dddd weekday names, zero padding 00000, time hh:mm, '#' with 0

B12.summary: CONT.SE/SOMASE criteria with a date written as text (">01/06/2024") are compared as text and match nothing
B12.culprit: nucleo.ts:64 (criterio: only plain numbers are parsed)

B13.summary: SEQUÊNCIA(0) / SEQUÊNCIA(-1) throw an uncaught TypeError when the cell is read (should be #CALC! / #VALOR!)
B13.culprit: nucleo.ts:357 + nucleo.ts:692 (r[0][0] on an empty array)

B14.summary: ÍNDICE returning an empty cell gives #REF! instead of 0; row/col 0 (whole column) unsupported; fractional indexes not truncated

B15.summary: 2^3^2 is right-associative (512); Excel evaluates ^ left to right (64)

B16.summary: Fractional index arguments are not truncated: PROCV col 2,7 → #REF!, ESCOLHER(2,7;…) → #VALOR!, MAIOR(…;1,5) → #NÚM!, ARRED(x;0,9) uses 10^0,9

B17.summary: "" (empty text, e.g. a cell with ="") used in arithmetic gives 0 instead of #VALOR!; VALOR("") gives 0

B18.summary: Number → text conversion keeps only 10 decimals ("x"&1/3 = x0,3333333333; Excel shows 15 significant digits)

B19.summary: Errors inside ranges are silently ignored by MAIOR/MENOR, SOMASE/MÉDIASE (sum range), PROCV with an error key

B20.summary: CONT.VALORES does not count cells holding "" from a formula, nor a literal "" argument (Excel does)

B21.summary: CONT.NÚM does not count numbers/booleans typed directly as arguments (CONT.NÚM("3";4)=2, CONT.NÚM(VERDADEIRO)=1 in Excel)

B22.summary: Text functions accept invalid sizes/positions instead of #VALOR!: ESQUERDA/DIREITA negative, EXT.TEXTO start 0 or negative length, LOCALIZAR/PROCURAR start 0, SUBSTITUIR occurrence 0, REPT negative

B23.summary: LOCALIZAR ignores wildcards (* ? ~) and is accent-insensitive (LOCALIZAR("ã";"maca")=2; Excel #VALOR!)

B25.summary: DIA.DA.SEMANA types 11–17 treated as type 1; invalid type not #NÚM!

B27.summary: TAXA fails (#NÚM!) when the true rate is 0 (TAXA(12;-100;1200))
B27.culprit: nucleo.ts:554-561 (g(x) switches formula at |x|<1e-12, derivative breaks)

B30.summary: CORRESP tipo other than -1/0/1 (e.g. 2) handled as -1; CORRESP of an empty cell finds the first blank instead of #N/D; PROCV approximate with a text key in a numeric column returns the last row instead of #N/D

B31.summary: Mismatched range sizes not rejected: SOMARPRODUTO(D1:D5;G1:G4), CONT.SES with different-size ranges (Excel #VALOR!); SOMASE with a 1-cell sum range is not expanded like Excel

B32.summary: ÚNICO ignores exatamente_uma_vez; CLASSIFICAR ignores por_col and an out-of-range índice

B33.summary: CONT.SE criterion "VERDADEIRO" does not match TRUE cells; criterion "#DIV/0!" does not match error cells; text criterion "7" does not match text '7' (while numeric 7 does)

B34.summary: VALOR does not parse times ("10:30"), scientific ("1e3") or accounting negatives ("(5)")

B35.summary: SE/NÃO do not accept the texts "VERDADEIRO"/"FALSO" as logical values (Excel IF("TRUE";…) works)
